name: ClaudeQR
description: Terminal-based QR bridge for managing Claude Code tmux sessions from a phone.
about:
A tool for launching and managing Claude Code CLI sessions with phone-based remote control. The bash launcher creates tmux sessions with a Node.js WebSocket server, displaying a QR code in the terminal for phone pairing. The phone web UI shows a hub of all active tmux/Claude sessions grouped by project, with status indicators (working, idle, shell, stale) and kill controls.

Predecessor to mobileTerm — the same session management concept evolved into a more polished form. Features token-based auth with persistent credentials and WebSocket multiplexing for streaming terminal output to the phone.
